source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចពោធិ៍សាត់ដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilient Orange Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 23pp
text:
Young trees need both feeding and physical protection to survive their first months in the field. Compost and balanced fertilizer are applied carefully so that fertilizer does not sit in direct contact with the young root system, which can burn tender roots.

Newly planted trees should also be protected from strong sun, wind, and animals (ការការពារកូនឈើ) - for example with shade material, stakes, or simple fencing - until they are well established. At this early stage, growers should also watch for and treat any pests in the nursery bed promptly, since a young tree has little reserve capacity to recover from pest damage.
